name: update_address
description: Change an address in the client's profile, or add a new delivery address to the profile for a replacement card.

client_id.description: Client identifier returned by find_client. Never invent one.

mode.description: Leave this out unless the advisor already said it. The system asks for it with buttons.

address_label.description: Which profile address to change (its label, e.g. Home). Leave this out; the system asks with buttons when there is more than one.

new_address.description: Never fill this. The advisor picks the new address from address suggestions shown by the system.

new_state.description: Never fill this; set by the system.

new_country.description: Never fill this; set by the system.
